wholePhysicalScope: OpenStreetMap way 924071838 identifies the named standing 18-node courthouse roof envelope. The west porch faces Scheaffe Street and the grounds are registered at Daintree Street.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the historic roofs, rhythmic posts and the two west gables. Near levels resolve the shutters and veranda balustrades.
limitations: This interpretation uses the current roof outline and the 1907 elevation and ground plan. Current paint, stair profile, minor veranda infill, annex heights and glazing are approximate.
Only the heritage courthouse complex is modeled. Detached outbuildings outside the courthouse outline and interior furnishings are outside scope.
